Our Mission

Bridging India
to the Stars

SKYLX AeroSpace is at the forefront of revolutionizing India's aerospace industry — pioneering reusable rockets and reliable, cutting-edge solutions. Our mission: make space accessible, sustainable, and affordable, empowering India's presence in the global space race.

Our Solution: Slash the Cost to Orbit

Current Cost

Government launchers: $9K–$10K/kg
Global commercial: $8K–$9K/kg

SKYLX Target

$4K–$6K/kg — up to 50% cheaper via Indian private launch vehicle

How?

Reusable rockets + repurposed automotive parts + rideshare services

LEO to GTO Missions

SKYLX Launch Vehicles

SKYLX is developing a family of three fully reusable launch vehicles designed to serve the complete commercial launch market — from small satellite constellations to large government and commercial payloads. All three vehicles are built with reusability as a core design principle, enabling rapid turnaround and significantly reduced launch costs.

Our Technology

Three Pillars of
Innovation

Reusable Landing Tech

Rockets return precisely to the launch pad — slashing turnaround times and making missions more sustainable.

Automotive Parts Repurposing

Proven automotive components adapted for rocket manufacturing — leveraging India's established supply chain to cut costs.

Rideshare Launch Services

"Carpool for satellites" — multiple clients share payload space, maximizing efficiency and minimizing per-mission cost.

About Us

Building India's Next Space Chapter

SKYLX AeroSpace is a private Indian aerospace company focused on reusable launch systems, cost-efficient access to orbit, and long-term space infrastructure that powers science, commerce, and national capability.

Our Mission

Make space launch more frequent, reliable, and affordable with reusable vehicles engineered for rapid turnaround.

What We Build

A family of launch vehicles from small to heavy class, supporting LEO and GTO missions for startups, enterprises, and public programs.

Why SKYLX

We combine advanced engineering, practical economics, and an India-first execution mindset to unlock commercial scale in space.

Our Vision

Build the launch backbone that carries Indian innovation beyond Earth and into the global space economy.
